video_title: Giannis picks Knicks to win NBA Finals & says Boston and Philly have best fans

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis predicts the Knicks will win the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I think Knicks, but I think Spurs will win on Sunday to go to the finals.

text_blocks.speaker: Marlon
text_blocks.text: I think Knicks, but I think Spurs will win on Sunday to go to the finals, you know?

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I think that I feel like Knicks will win the whole thing. Because basketball, there is momentum. One like living in a row, they can keep going on that, right? And you know the city just rallies behind them.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis identifies Boston and Philadelphia as having the best fans
quotes.excerpt: I feel like the best arena was Boston, Philly. Yeah, they go crazy.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I feel like the best arena was Boston, Philly. Yeah, they go crazy. Philly, Boston, and then they have passionate fans.

text_blocks.speaker: Marlon
text_blocks.text: Is that like a regular game or like more like playoff? Regular game?

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Playoff, playoff they go crazy. Everybody go crazy in playoff. But regular game, Boston, passionate, Philadelphia 76ers, they have passionate fans. That's my team, they are in the arena.
